name: BFF-Bench
description: A novel benchmark created to evaluate the ability of LLM Judges to grade correctness of responses to conversational questions, with human-annotated labels for 1,200 LLM responses. It highlights limitations of LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks without human grounding and explores the impact of reference answer quality on judge performance.
reputation: A recent benchmark for LLM-as-a-Judge research that has attracted interest for studying judge reliability, though it is not yet a long-established community standard.
notes: Includes a human-annotated dataset of 1,200 LLM responses; emphasizes the importance of human-written reference answers for reliable LLM judging.
